name: milk bikis
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT & REFINED PALM OIL, MILK PRODUCTS (8.7%) [MILK SOLIDS & SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK], LIQUID GLUCOSE, EDIBLE MAIZE STARCH, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 500(ii) & 341(i)], EMULSIFIERS [322(i) & 471], IODISED SALT, MINERALS**, ARTIFICIAL (MILK) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND VITAMINS*. (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SOY.
